regulations.title: Hazardous and Other Wastes (Management and Transboundary Movement) Rules, 2016
regulations.key_requirements: Mandatory manifest system, authorized TSDF disposal or co-processing for used core sand and hazardous residues.

regulations.title: BRSR Core Value Chain Disclosures Framework (March 2025)
regulations.key_requirements: Voluntary ESG self-assessment for MSME suppliers to top 250 listed Indian entities.

regulations.title: EU Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (Definitive Regime)
regulations.key_requirements: Scope 1 and Scope 2 embedded emission reporting on iron, steel, and aluminium exports to the EU.

regulations.title: Fly Ash Utilisation Notification (S.O. 5481(E))
regulations.key_requirements: 100% ash utilisation in construction products within 300 km radius of thermal plants.
